artifacts.summary: Live selection scorecard under the current 80/80 caps: additions, omissions, abstentions, emphasis and per-encounter coverage.
Text-scrubbed narration trial: agent vs direct fallback, accepted narration, per-sentence citations and the grounding verifier totals.
Repeated runs of the borderline paraphrase case, aggregated; per-run rows sit beside it.
Paired floor/margin ablation replaying one recorded answer set under production thresholds and all three at zero.
Authored claim pairs classified as agreement, contradiction, absent or not-comparable between produced additions and structured records.
Synthetic, non-operational content-safety probe result; absence is also reported by the renderer.
Synthetic import/index dry run at the assumed 50,000-profile delivery shape: wall time, disk footprint, peak RSS, one-encounter resolution and full-record reconciliation.

description: Index of every measurement artifact cited by the derived evidence document, by kind. The renderer and claim checker resolve artifact paths here rather than hardcoding artifact filenames.
